name: QueueLess Ethiopia
description: A digital queue management platform that eliminates physical waiting lines at service centers across Ethiopia, allowing customers to join queues remotely, track their position in real-time, receive estimated waiting times, and get notifications when it's their turn.
problem: QueueLess Ethiopia solves the problem of physical waiting lines at service centers across Ethiopia. Customers waste hours waiting at government offices, hospitals, banks, telecom centers, and other service providers. The platform lets them join queues remotely, track their position in real-time, receive estimated waiting times, and get notifications when its their turn.
target_users: Customers - people who need services and want to join queues remotely or book appointments
Staff - employees at service centers who manage queues, call next customers, and mark them as served
Organization administrators - managers of service centers who configure services, staff, queues, and working hours
Platform administrators - operators who manage the entire platform including organizations, users, and system configuration

user_selected_technologies.name: Firebase Cloud Messaging
user_selected_technologies.purpose: push notifications for turn alerts and updates

deployment: Containerized deployment using Docker with Nginx reverse proxy
